import itertools, sys, time
sys.path[:0]=['/workspace/tmp/tests','/opt/emicro-deps','/workspace/project']
from ebpf.create_dfa import create, registry_columns
names=['S%02d'%i for i in range(16)]
reg=[{'name':n,'label':i+1} for i,n in enumerate(names)]
cols,colmap=registry_columns(reg)
for L in (10,12,13,14):
    words=list(itertools.product(['S00','S01'],repeat=L))
    psvc=sum(len(w) for w in words)
    txt=' '.join('match(%s) allow;'%','.join(w) for w in words)
    t=time.time()
    try:
        img=create(txt,cols,colmap)
        print('all len%d over 2 (%d psvc) rows=%d cells=%d %.2fs'%(L,psvc,len(img.rows),img.cells,time.time()-t))
    except Exception as e:
        print('all len%d over 2 (%d psvc) %s:%s %.2fs'%(L,psvc,type(e).__name__,str(e)[:20],time.time()-t))
EOF
